attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as router between lan-a (node2, eth1, 10.60.10.0/24) and lan-b (node3, eth2, 10.60.20.0/24): added static interface addresses on node1's eth1/eth2, persistent ens7 addresses+routes on node2/node3 (Ubuntu 16.04, via /etc/network/interfaces.d), and a VyOS ipv4 forward filter with rule 5 (accept established/related), rule 10 (accept TCP/5432 from eth1->eth2 only), rule 900 (reject all else), default-action drop. Verified node2->node3:5432 succeeds while ping and other TCP ports are rejected. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes sequentially (node1 router first, then node2, then node3), confirming changed boot_id on each and re-verifying the firewall policy and config persistence after each restart.
